review_cost.rationale: A round of small-to-moderate changes before approving: fix the trigger bug, consolidate the duplicated card-building code, centralise NotFoundError handling, and remove dead code — nothing structural.

findings.issue: Filter form's hx-trigger='input changed delay:200ms, change' double-fires for selects (Chromium emits both input and change), issuing two requests and pushing the same URL twice, so Back needs two presses after changing Type/Generation.
findings.suggestion: Split triggers per control (delayed input on the search field, change on the selects) or gate the input trigger to the search input, e.g. hx-trigger="search changed delay:250ms from:#search, change from:select".

findings.issue: getPokemonMoveInfo fires one fetch per unique move of the selected game via Promise.all — a move-heavy Pokémon (Mew, ~190 moves) triggers ~200 concurrent API requests on first render, with no concurrency limit.
findings.suggestion: Fetch move details with a bounded concurrency pool (e.g. batched chunks), or lazily fetch only per method group rendered; the cache makes this a first-hit cost only, but it is still a burst on the request path.

findings.issue: The 'refs → dedupe by species id → sort → pokemonCard' logic is implemented three times with slight variations (speciesCardsForRefs, the /abilities route, the /types route), and speciesCardsForRefs' hiddenBySpecies option — including its function-value branch — is dead code (only call site at server.mjs:615 passes nothing).
findings.suggestion: Keep one shared helper that takes an optional hidden-set, delete the function-value branch, and use it from all three routes.

findings.issue: Five identical per-route try/catch blocks translating NotFoundError into the 404 page, next to an app.onError that already centralises error responses.
findings.suggestion: Handle NotFoundError once in app.onError (checking error instanceof NotFoundError) and drop the per-route try/catch.

findings.issue: Every c.html(...) call wraps the html`...` result in String(), deviating from the documented c.html(html`...`) pattern; the coercion is harmless but adds noise in ~12 places and discards Hono's HtmlEscapedString metadata.
findings.suggestion: Return the html template result directly from c.html() as the hono/html docs demonstrate.

findings.issue: outerHTML swaps of #moves and the moves tables remove the focused element (game select, sort button) on every interaction, losing keyboard focus.
findings.suggestion: Swap a narrower container (e.g. the tables wrapper, leaving the select in place) or re-focus the triggering element after the swap.

findings.issue: Unbounded module-level promise cache with no eviction or TTL; fine for the fixed snapshot but silently unbounded if the API data grows.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable given the spec explicitly allows runtime in-memory caching; optionally add a size cap or TTL to future-proof.

findings.issue: Dead code: typeBadge imported but unused in server.mjs, capitalize exported but never called, and the species catalog builds a byName map that is never read.
findings.suggestion: Delete the unused import and exports.

findings.issue: Three hand-written serveStatic routes for the three static assets instead of one middleware; every new asset needs a new route.
findings.suggestion: Use a single app.use('/static/*', serveStatic({ root: ... })) or app.use('*', serveStatic(...)) pattern per @hono/node-server docs.

findings.issue: The moves-table partial throws NotFoundError when a method has no rows, which would swap a full 404 HTML document into the table position; unreachable via normal clicks but a landmine if the endpoint is reused.
findings.suggestion: Render an empty table (or 204) instead of throwing for empty method rows in a partial endpoint.

summary: A careful, current-idiom Hono + htmx app: sound escaping, thorough 404 handling, a race-safe promise cache, and clean URL state management, wrapped in a well-named api/format/views layer. The main merge blockers are a select double-fire that pushes duplicate history entries, an unbounded fetch fan-out for move details on first render, triplicated card-list building with dead option machinery, and a monolithic 812-line server.mjs. Approvable after one round of focused cleanups; nothing structural needs rework.
